name: Franime
description: French anime catalogue (franime.fr API) with VOSTFR (vo/sub) and VF (dub) episodes resolved via sibnet, vidmoly, uqload, dailymotion, vk and sendvid embeds, with HLS quality ladders and enriched episode titles. High-resolution posters and a 512x512 header icon. Text search uses the public Kitsu index with bounded per-hit franime verification and a Kitsu-card fallback so search never hard-fails.
